review: Written for OpenPath: English sounds that Tamil speakers often mix up. Not yet reviewed by a teacher.

groups.name: v and w
groups.tip: For v, rest your top teeth on your bottom lip and buzz. For w, round your lips like a kiss; no teeth touch.

groups.name: f and p
groups.tip: For f, rest your top teeth on your bottom lip and blow. For p, close both lips, then pop them open.

groups.name: z and j
groups.tip: For z, keep your teeth close and buzz like a bee: zzz. For j, start with your tongue up, as in jam.

groups.name: s and sh
groups.tip: For s, smile a little and hiss: sss. For sh, push your lips forward, as when you ask someone to be quiet.

groups.name: th and t
groups.tip: For th, put the tip of your tongue between your teeth and blow gently. For t, your tongue taps behind your top teeth.

groups.name: short i and long ee
groups.tip: Short i is quick and relaxed: ship. Long ee is longer, with a wide smile: sheep.
